about: REAL SuggestRequest payloads emitted by the content script (extension/src/content/scan.ts running the bundled automation/observation.js) in Chromium, captured by the mock-background rig of extension/tests/content on the rig's fixtures (choices, combobox), the repository's ATS fixtures (greenhouse, lever, ashby_trainline, inline_questions) and conditional.html (next to this file). Only document ids and the loopback port were normalised. Regenerate with capture_scans.py when scan.ts or observation.js changes an element's shape. Used by backend/tests/test_extension_suggest.py to pin the group-representative convention and the partial-refresh behaviour.
